subject: CloudEdge marketplace: residency exceptions & deletion propagation clarifications
messages:
From: Sofia Morales <sofia@cloudedge.io>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Questions on Marketplace residency & deletion exceptions

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for walking us through the marketplace listing checklist yesterday. A couple of follow-up items from our compliance team — hoping you can confirm how Redwood handles a few edge cases so we can finalize our internal security sign-off: 

1) If we set EU-only routing for our account (data stays in eu-west-1), are snapshots/backups ever copied to other regions for disaster recovery? If so, what's the retention and deletion policy for those backups?

2) We have a requirement to fully delete customer data within 30 days of request, including any cached prefixes or KV caches used by inference. How does deletion propagate to cached objects and any persisted async logs for marketplace listings?

3) For customers who onboard via marketplace procurement (AWS Marketplace, GCP Marketplace, Azure Marketplace), are there any marketplace-specific retention flags or metadata Redwood adds that we need to surface to our legal team?

We'd like short, bullet answers we can drop into our internal compliance checklist. If helpful, we've attached a small table of the retention expectations on our side (see retention-matrix.xlsx).

Appreciate it —
Sofia
Sofia Morales
Head of Platform Security, CloudEdge
sofia@cloudedge.io

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Sofia Morales <sofia@cloudedge.io>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-07T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on Marketplace residency & deletion exceptions

Hi Sofia — thanks for the clear list. Answers below (short bullets so you can paste into your checklist). I also attached our quick matrix and a dataflow diagram for the marketplace path.

1) Backups & snapshots:
- Primary: customer runtime data (tokens, prompts, outputs) routed/stored to the region you select (eu-west-1) and stays there for both active and S3-backed cold stores by default.
- DR snapshots: for customers on Redwood Hosted marketplace listings, we do maintain encrypted cross-region DR snapshots only when the account opts into multi-region DR during onboarding (explicit checkbox). By default we do NOT copy backups cross-region.
- If DR is enabled: snapshots copied to a secondary region are encrypted with a region-scoped CMK and retained per the DR retention policy (default 90 days). Deletion requests will mark both primary and DR snapshots for deletion; DR snapshot deletion happens within the configured retention window unless you request immediate purge (see SLA note).

2) Deletion propagation (30-day requirement):
- Customer hard-delete request triggers: (a) account data store purge, (b) cache invalidation for prefix/KV caches, and (c) flagging async logs for expedited deletion.
- KV/prefix caches: invalidated immediately; cached tokens are excluded from future inference and removed from edge caches within 24 hours; full purge of ephemeral caches completes within 30 days depending on TTLs.
- Logs and observability exports: platform metrics/trace spans that contain PII are redacted on delete; raw observability exports persisted to long-term storage follow the marketplace retention policy and will be scheduled for deletion — we can expedite with an exception request.

3) Marketplace metadata / flags:
- For AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace customers we add a \"marketplace_listing\" metadata flag and a purchase order id line to the account entity. This metadata does not contain customer PII and is used for billing reconciliation only.
- No automatic extension of retention because the purchase came from a marketplace — retention follows the account-level configuration unless you select Marketplace DR.

Next steps:
- If CloudEdge wants guaranteed immediate cross-region purge on delete, we can add an exception in the onboarding flow (requires an Ops SLA change).
- I've attached retention-matrix.xlsx and marketplace-data-flow-diagram.png. Laura — tagging you for any legal/ops notes on the immediate purge SLA.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com

Cc: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-07T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on Marketplace residency & deletion exceptions

Thanks — a few compliance clarifications from Legal/Privacy: 

- Backups: confirm that if CloudEdge opts OUT of multi-region DR we will add explicit language to the SOW/Marketplace addendum that backups will remain in eu-west-1 and that Redwood will not perform cross-region restoration without documented approval. I'll include a short clause template we use in addenda.

- Immediate purge: operationally possible but high-risk if requested for very short notice windows because some telemetry pipelines buffer to immutable stores for up to 7 days. We can implement an \"expedited purge\" workflow (30 day default -> 72 hour expedited window for account-level exception) with a one-time fee or contract amendment.

- Audit trail: when a deletion request is processed we will provide an audit bundle (manifest + deletion job ids + checksum list) within 5 business days. This bundle will reference any DR snapshot ids as well.

Action items:
- Jonas: please confirm pricing & SLA language for the expedited purge add-on and I will draft the addendum.
- Alex: please create INF-1428 in Jira to track implementation work (retention flags, expedited purge workflow).

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal Ops, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
